title: Pit Firing Outing
source_quote: The pit firing event will be on March 8th from 10 AM. The event will be in Monticello, IN, about a 45 minute drive from Lafayette.
evidence_sentence: The page describes a pit firing outing scheduled for March 8th at 10 AM in Monticello, Indiana.
evidence_quote: The pit firing event will be on March 8th from 10 AM.
summary: A pit firing outing for Guild members and interested potters in Monticello, Indiana on March 8th at 10 AM. Bring dry ceramic pieces prepared with surface treatments; the guild provides saggers and some colorants.
bring: Dry ceramic pieces, Terra Sigillata optional, colorants such as copper wire, oxides, salt, walnut hulls, or other combustibles if desired
how_to_join: Click the signup link on the pit firing event page to register and receive email details
